### 🚀 Real-time Cryptocurrency Market Intelligence Pipeline

CryptoFlow Analytics is an end-to-end data pipeline that ingests multi-source crypto data, transforms it through a medallion architecture, and produces actionable market intelligence — including a Market Regime Detector, Composite Momentum Signals, and Sentiment Analysis — all orchestrated by [Bruin](https://getbruin.com).

This project was built for the **[Bruin x DE Zoomcamp 2026 Project Competition](https://getbruin.com/zoomcamp-project/)**.

#### 🎯 Key Features

- **Market Regime Detector**: Automatically classifies market conditions (Bull, Bear, Sideways) based on price action and volatility.
- **AI Analyst Insights**: Leverages Bruin's AI capabilities to provide automated market commentary and highlighted signals.
- **Medallion Architecture**: Robust data engineering with Bronze (Raw), Silver (Staging), and Gold (Analytics) layers in **BigQuery**.
- **Data Quality**: Integrated data validation using Bruin's built-in and custom quality checks.
